title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Steelix Mega Brave 045/063 Holo Rare Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Steelix card featured in the product is a rare holo from the m1L: Mega Brave set of the Pokémon TCG. This Japanese-language card, produced by The Pokémon Company, is part of the collection known for its unique character design and collectability among fans of the game. With a striking holo finish and originating from Japan, this Steelix card holds a special appeal to collectors looking to add a rare and visually appealing piece to their collection.
